title: Quick-Fix: Convert Public Field to Property at Cursor
summary: Rewrites a public field under the caret as a property
intro: Read this when you are tightening a class public surface. With the caret on a public field, this rewrites it as a property.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Convert Public Field to Property at Cursor
steps: Put the caret on the public field declaration in the class
Choose drag-lint > Convert Public Field to Property at Cursor
The field is rewritten as a property

questions.ask: How do I turn a public field into a property?
questions.command: drag-lint > Convert Public Field to Property at Cursor

questions.ask: Can I wrap a public field without editing every use by hand?
questions.command: drag-lint > Convert Public Field to Property at Cursor
